Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us. Wed like to schedule a compact virtual full-loop on Tuesday, 18 Aug. Proposed structure below (all PDT):

- 10:00–10:30 — System Design (Hiring Manager + Eng Lead)
- 10:40–11:10 — Coding exercise (Peer interviewer)
- 11:20–11:45 — Product/PM fit (PM partner)
- 12:00–12:20 — Culture & wrap (Recruiter + EM)

Total wall-time: ~2.5 hours including short breaks. We can compress into two blocks if preferred (10:00–11:30 / 11:40–12:20) — tell me which you prefer.

Please confirm your availability windows on 18 Aug (PDT) and tell us your timezone if different. Ive attached your resume and our working agenda.

Notes for the team: if Alex prefers a morning in EST we should mirror to the equivalent late-morning PST slot. If we go with the 2-block flow, well sequence interviews so that the coding session follows system design for context.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Thanks — Ill follow up with candidate confirmation and calendar links.
